title: Owl

description.en: A macOS menu bar lookout that spots unusual patterns in your system logs.
description.zh: 守在 macOS 菜单栏里的观察员，从系统日志中发现异常信号。

subject: Compact tawny owl holding one multicolored feather

source.description: macOS menu bar system health monitor via unified log stream anomaly detection

subject.en: Compact tawny owl holding one multicolored feather
subject.zh: 衔着一根多彩羽毛的灰褐色猫头鹰

description.en: A compact whole owl tilts its head, with both eyes, folded wings and every talon visible. One feather extends from the beak into the surrounding space.
description.zh: 完整的小猫头鹰微微侧头，双眼、折叠双翼和脚爪清晰可见。一根羽毛从喙边伸向留白。

description.en: Broad neutral facets organize the plumage. Cream facial discs and amber eyes preserve recognition; the feather is the only multicolored accessory.
description.zh: 大块中性色切面组织羽毛，奶油色面盘与琥珀眼睛保持辨识度，羽毛是唯一的多彩配件。

description.en: Interrupted crescent steps and offset notches form a smoky-blue observatory field. The pattern stays distinct from feather stripes and light orbits.
description.zh: 中断的弧形台阶与错位缺口构成烟蓝色夜间窗口，几何形态与羽毛条纹和光线轨道不同。

palette.source: Selected Owl presentation, 2026-09-07-01/01; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: The complete bird and feather have at least 193.5 px of rounded-edge clearance. The native popover uses a transparent 22 pt mark; macOS app icons use a separate rounded tile with a platform inset. Browser specimens demonstrate the identity at small sizes.
sizeNote.zh: 完整鸟身和羽毛距圆角边界至少 193.5 px。原生弹窗使用透明的 22 pt 小标，macOS 应用图标使用带平台留白的独立圆角底图。浏览器样例用于检视缩小效果。

goal.en: Inspect Mac system metrics and processes from the menu bar, and detect recurring crashes, resource pressure, sleep problems, and device anomalies locally.
goal.zh: 在菜单栏查看 Mac 系统指标与进程，在本机发现反复崩溃、资源压力、睡眠和设备异常。

role.en: Menu bar, metrics and settings UI
role.zh: 菜单栏、指标与设置界面
单元与检测管道集成测试

description.en: Interrupted crescents and two rectangular notches suggest an observatory aperture opening into the night.
description.zh: 断续月牙与两处矩形缺口组成观测孔径，像镜头缓缓打开夜色。

alt.en: Compact tawny owl holding one multicolored feather on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 衔着一根多彩羽毛的灰褐色猫头鹰，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.zh: 看见日志里值得留意的变化。

description.en: Compact tawny owl holding one multicolored feather.
description.zh: 衔着一根多彩羽毛的灰褐色猫头鹰。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥44px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 44px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
